subject: MedCo compliance review & IR evidence next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@medco.com>, Ian Cooper <ian.cooper@medco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:15:00 -0500
Subject: MedCo compliance review & IR evidence next steps

Hi Tara / Ian —

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the time and the clear risk-prioritization you shared. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can loop in Security and Procurement on our side: 

1) Scope & regs
- You confirmed MedCo will require HIPAA (PHI) coverage for telemetry and any data stored in our private deployment. GDPR is in-scope for EU users only.
- Primary systems for consideration: patient-notifications, claims-proxy, analytics-service.

2) Compliance artifacts requested (helpful to accelerate procurement):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is ok) — target to receive within 7–10 business days if available
- BCP / DR executive summary with RTO/RPO targets and recent tabletop outcomes
- Point of contact for incident notifications (name + email + escalation phone)

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- Attached: Redwood-Vendor-Questionnaire-MedCo.xlsx — this is our standard questionnaire (focus areas: access control, encryption, incident response, subprocessor list). Please complete and return; we can also accept answers via your shared Confluence/SharePoint link.

4) Timeline & next steps
- Can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II already exists or if we should expect an SOC 2 in progress?
- Please confirm target date to return the questionnaire (we typically ask for 5–7 business days).
- If you can provide an initial IR timeline (notification SLA, forensic evidence retention windows), that would help us map contract terms.

I'll follow up with our Security lead (Evelyn) once we have your SOC/BCP docs so she can review the scope and flag any additional evidence required for HIPAA scope.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: karthik.iyer@redwood.com | Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Questionnaire-MedCo.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 84KB)

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@medco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ian Cooper <ian.cooper@medco.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MedCo compliance review & IR evidence next steps

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary and the questionnaire. Quick answers to the bullets: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II from Q4 2024. We can provide a redacted copy for vendor review. Expect a PDF.
- BCP/DR: Attached is a short executive summary with RTO/RPO for affected services, plus notes from a recent tabletop in Nov 2025.
- Incident notification: For now, use security@medco.com and cc me (tara.singh@medco.com). Our escalation roster includes Ian Cooper (CTO) and our on-call forensic lead, Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@medco.com).

Regarding the questionnaire: we will try to complete the spreadsheet, but our security team prefers to respond to targeted questions rather than full vendor questionnaires. If possible, can you flag 8–10 priority questions you need answered first (SOC/IR/crypto/subprocessors)? That will speed things up on our side.

I'll attach the SOC2 redacted and the BCP summary in my next email — sending separately for confidentiality controls.

Regards,
Tara Singh
Head of Security & Compliance | MedCo Health
T: 646-555-0238

Attachment: MedCo-BCP-Executive-Summary.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: MedCo compliance review & IR evidence next steps

Evelyn — forwarding Tara's note and the BCP summary attached.

Can you: 
- Review the BCP exec summary for RTO/RPO alignment with our SLAs (aim: RTO <= 4h for prod inference; RPO <= 15m for KV cache)
- Identify the 8–10 priority questionnaire items we should surface to Tara to speed their response (SOC scope, notification SLA, encryption-at-rest key ownership, subprocessor list)
- Let me know if the redacted SOC2 will be sufficient, or if we need a SOC2 bridge letter / additional evidence (logs, retention policy, IR playbook)

Quick context: MedCo has PHI in scope; they confirmed SOC2 Type II exists. They prefer limited Qs first.

Thanks — I’ll send the prioritized list back to Tara (and copy Laura for procurement).

—Karthik

Karthik / Evelyn —

Following up with the artifacts we discussed. Attaching our redacted SOC 2 Type II and the BCP executive summary. A few notes and commitments on timeline so you can feed this into procurement: 

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): attached. If you require non-redacted detail for legal review, we can consider a controlled review under NDA.
- BCP/DR executive summary: attached; RTO/RPO by critical service included. Recent tabletop (Nov 2025) covered failover to DR region and external vendor continuity.
- Incident response timeline (MedCo commitment): 
  • Initial acknowledgement: within 1 hour of verified incident report (security@medco.com)
  • Customer notification (if impacted): within 72 hours
  • Forensic report / evidence package: 7–14 business days depending on scope; expedited packaging available under contractual SLA.

We will also complete the vendor questionnaire but will start by answering your prioritized list. For speed, please send the top 10 questions you want addressed first.

Point people for IR escalation:
- security@medco.com (primary inbox)
- Tara Singh (Head of Security) — tara.singh@medco.com
- Ian Cooper (CTO) — ian.cooper@medco.com
- Marco Diaz (Forensics Lead) — marco.diaz@medco.com

If you need the SOC2 redaction adjusted (remove customer names / routing info), tell us what fields require redaction and we can regenerate.

Thanks,
Tara
